info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create It Management Development Environment-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the establishment of development environments within IT management frameworks. It enables organizations to efficiently set up and configure necessary environments tailored for their banking services. Typical consumers include IT teams and software developers who require swift and reliable setups for testing and development purposes. By standardizing the creation process, this API helps streamline workflows and enhances productivity in the banking sector.

post.description: This operation allows users to create and configure a new development environment in the IT management system, enabling the necessary setup for development work to begin efficiently.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or configure a new development environment within the IT management system. It should contain all necessary parameters and configurations for setting up the environment.

201.description: The development environment resource has been successfully created.

dataClassification.description: Classification of data processed in the environment (e.g., Public, Internal, Confidential).
